# Agent API reference

<!-- Generated by apps/desktop/scripts/agent-api-reference.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page lists every tool Memry's MCP server offers and every desktop API operation those tools
reach, with each argument's type, whether it is required, the values it takes, and an example call
with the reply a running Memry gave. It is written for agents and the people who set them up, so an
agent never has to read the app's own files to find out how to call it.

**Describes Memry `2026.928.1+main`.** A version ending in `+main` means the reference
was regenerated from the source after that release, and the next release ships it. The reference
is generated from the schemas Memry checks every call against, the same schemas behind
`vault_desktop_describe` and the `VALIDATION` errors, and is regenerated for each release.

The same content as JSON Schema (draft 2020-12), for an agent to fetch:
[https://docs.memrynote.com/agent-api/memry-agent-api.schema.json](/agent-api/memry-agent-api.schema.json). Its `$defs` hold one entry per
tool (the `arguments` object) and one per desktop operation (the `args` array), each
with its description, whether it needs approval, and the example below.

## Calling a tool

Memry serves MCP over HTTP at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp`, with the bearer token from
Settings -> AI Assistant -> Agent MCP. See [Agent Chat & MCP Server](./agent-mcp#connection) for
the connection, and for which clients may write. A tool call is a JSON-RPC `tools/call`
request:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": { "name": "vault_search_notes", "arguments": { "query": "budget", "limit": 5 } }
}
```

The reply's `result.content[0].text` is the JSON shown as the reply in each example below.
A refused call sets `result.isError` and its text is `{ code, message, details }`.
Example ids, dates and times come from a test vault; arrays in a reply are cut to their first
three entries and long strings are shortened, marked `…`.

Write tools pause for the owner's approval unless the owner set confirmations to **Always allow**,
and only a turn Memry itself runs can write. A call whose arguments do not match the schema is
refused with `VALIDATION` before any approval, and nothing runs. Every tool refuses an
argument it does not take.

## Named tools

### Read tools

#### vault_search_notes

Full-text search across notes and filed files; returns id, title, snippet, folder_path, file_type. A file_type other than "markdown" (pdf/image/audio/video) is a filed file, not a note. PDFs and images match on the text read out of them on this device, and a note matches on the visible text of the HTML blocks it embeds. Pass file_types to restrict the search, e.g. ["markdown"] for notes only; omitted returns every file type. Each hit carries sync, as vault_read_note describes.

Read tool.

| Argument     | Type                                                       | Required | Allowed values             |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------- |
| `query`      | `string`                                                   | yes      | min length `1`             |
| `limit`      | `integer`                                                  | no       | max `50`; greater than `0` |
| `folder_id`  | `string`                                                   | no       | min length `1`             |
| `file_types` | `("markdown" \| "pdf" \| "image" \| "audio" \| "video")[]` | no       | min items `1`              |

Example call:

```json
{
  "query": "relaunch",
  "limit": 5
}
```

Reply:

```json
[
  {
    "id": "<noteId>",
    "title": "Website relaunch plan",
    "snippet": "# Website <mark>relaunch</mark> plan\n\nSecond draft.\n\n## Goals\n\n- Faster pages\n- Clearer pricing\n\nSee [[Launch checklist]].\n",
    "folder_path": "Projects",
    "file_type": "markdown",
    "href": "memry://note/<noteId>",
    "source_ref": {
      "kind": "note",
      "id": "<noteId>",
      "title": "Website relaunch plan",
      "href": "memry://note/<noteId>"
    }
  }
]
```

#### vault_read_note

Read a markdown note by id; returns full markdown content + metadata. For a filed pdf or image, returns extracted_text instead: the text read on this device (the PDF text layer, else OCR), one entry per page, with status "extracting" \| "done" \| "failed", page_count and pages_read. Pages come in chunks of about 100 KB; pass next_page as from_page to continue. A markdown note that embeds PDFs, images or HTML blocks adds attachment_text, the text read from each ({ file, text }; the visible text for an HTML block), about 100 KB at most. Errors with VALIDATION for a filed audio or video file. To look at an image or a PDF page, use vault_view_file. sync says whether the note's latest text reached the server: state "pending" (changes waiting on this device, since waiting_since), "sent" (a push has no answer yet), "confirmed" (the server stored the last body push, at body_confirmed_at), "not_recorded" (nothing waiting, no confirmed push recorded yet), "rejected" (the server refused the latest push), "local_only" or "not_syncing". After a write, read again until state is "confirmed" and body_confirmed_at is later than the write.

Read tool.

| Argument    | Type      | Required | Allowed values                           |
| ----------- | --------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `id`        | `string`  | yes      | min length `1`                           |
| `from_page` | `integer` | no       | max `9007199254740991`; greater than `0` |

Example call:

```json
{
  "id": "<noteId>"
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "id": "<noteId>",
  "title": "Website relaunch plan",
  "content_markdown": "# Website relaunch plan\n\nSecond draft.\n\n## Goals\n\n- Faster pages\n- Clearer pricing\n\nSee [[Launch checklist]].\n",
  "tags": ["website", "planning"],
  "folder_path": "Projects",
  "frontmatter": {
    "tags": ["website", "planning"],
    "stage": "idea",
    "project": ["Website relaunch"]
  },
  "file_type": "markdown",
  "href": "memry://note/<noteId>",
  "source_ref": {
    "kind": "note",
    "id": "<noteId>",
    "title": "Website relaunch plan",
    "href": "memry://note/<noteId>"
  },
  "sources": [
    {
      "kind": "note",
      "id": "<noteId>",
      "title": "Website relaunch plan",
      "href": "memry://note/<noteId>"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### vault_view_file

Look at an image, or one page of a PDF, from the vault. Returns the picture as image content (PNG, or JPEG when large) with its long edge at most 1568 px, plus JSON that says what was sent: file, width and height, the source size for an image, and page and page_count for a PDF. Pass the id of a filed image or PDF (file_type "image" or "pdf"); page picks the PDF page, default 1, one page per call. For an image or PDF a markdown note embeds, pass the note id and the file name as attachment: the name after attachments/&lt;note id>/ in the note, or attachment_text[].file from vault_read_note. A model that cannot take images gets a text notice instead of the picture.

Read tool.

| Argument     | Type      | Required | Allowed values                           |
| ------------ | --------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `id`         | `string`  | yes      | min length `1`                           |
| `attachment` | `string`  | no       | min length `1`                           |
| `page`       | `integer` | no       | max `9007199254740991`; greater than `0` |

Example call:

```json
{
  "id": "<noteId>",
  "attachment": "<attachmentName>"
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "json": {
    "id": "<noteId>",
    "title": "Website relaunch plan",
    "attachment": "<attachmentName>",
    "file": "attachments/<noteId>/<attachmentName>",
    "file_type": "image",
    "mime_type": "image/png",
    "width": 48,
    "height": 48,
    "source_width": 48,
    "source_height": 48,
    "message": "The image follows as image content at 48 x 48 px.",
    "href": "memry://note/<noteId>",
    "source_ref": {
      "kind": "note",
      "id": "<noteId>",
      "title": "Website relaunch plan",
      "href": "memry://note/<noteId>"
    },
    "sources": [
      {
        "kind": "note",
        "id": "<noteId>",
        "title": "Website relaunch plan",
        "href": "memry://note/<noteId>"
      }
    ]
  },
  "image": {
    "type": "image",
    "mimeType": "image/png",
    "data": "<4620 bytes of base64>"
  }
}
```

#### vault_list_folder

List the sub-folders and notes in a folder, addressed by path (as returned in folder_path/path fields); omit path for the vault root. Paths are vault-relative with no leading slash ("projects/active"); a leading slash is also accepted. A folder that does not exist fails with NOT_FOUND. recursive includes every nested level instead of direct children only. Returns at most 1000 notes. Each note entry carries file_type; a filed pdf/image/audio/video file lists as kind "file", not "note". Each note entry carries sync, as vault_read_note describes.

Read tool.

| Argument    | Type      | Required | Allowed values |
| ----------- | --------- | -------- | -------------- |
| `path`      | `string`  | no       |                |
| `id`        | `string`  | no       | min length `1` |
| `recursive` | `boolean` | no       |                |

Example call:

```json
{
  "path": "Projects"
}
```

Reply:

```json
[
  {
    "kind": "note",
    "id": "<noteId>",
    "name": "Website relaunch plan",
    "path": "Projects/Website relaunch plan.md",
    "file_type": "markdown",
    "href": "memry://note/<noteId>",
    "source_ref": {
      "kind": "note",
      "id": "<noteId>",
      "title": "Website relaunch plan",
      "href": "memry://note/<noteId>"
    }
  },
  {
    "kind": "file",
    "id": "<fileId>",
    "name": "report",
    "path": "Projects/report.pdf",
    "file_type": "pdf",
    "href": "memry://note/<fileId>",
    "source_ref": {
      "kind": "note",
      "id": "<fileId>",
      "title": "report",
      "href": "memry://note/<fileId>"
    }
  },
  {
    "kind": "note",
    "id": "<deleteNote2Id>",
    "name": "Scratch 2",
    "path": "Projects/Scratch 2.md",
    "file_type": "markdown",
    "href": "memry://note/<deleteNote2Id>",
    "source_ref": {
      "kind": "note",
      "id": "<deleteNote2Id>",
      "title": "Scratch 2",
      "href": "memry://note/<deleteNote2Id>"
    }
  }
]
```

#### vault_list_tasks

List tasks, optionally filtered. status is "open" (not completed), "completed", or a status id from vault_list_statuses; omitted, completed tasks are excluded. due_before is an ISO date; tag matches one tag name. Returns id, title, status label, due, project id, and tags.

Read tool.

| Argument     | Type      | Required | Allowed values              |
| ------------ | --------- | -------- | --------------------------- |
| `status`     | `string`  | no       |                             |
| `project_id` | `string`  | no       | min length `1`              |
| `due_before` | `string`  | no       |                             |
| `tag`        | `string`  | no       |                             |
| `limit`      | `integer` | no       | max `200`; greater than `0` |

Example call:

```json
{
  "status": "open",
  "project_id": "<projectId>",
  "limit": 5
}
```

Reply:

```json
[
  {
    "id": "<taskId>",
    "title": "Write landing page copy",
    "status": "open",
    "due": "2026-10-09",
    "project": "<projectId>",
    "tags": ["website"],
    "href": "memry://task/<taskId>",
    "source_ref": {
      "kind": "task",
      "id": "<taskId>",
      "title": "Write landing page copy",
      "href": "memry://task/<taskId>"
    }
  },
  {
    "id": "ztuhBvw-P3_1skGUZE4Xv",
```

#### vault_get_journal_entry

Return the journal entry for an ISO date or null. It carries sync, as vault_read_note describes.

Read tool.

| Argument | Type     | Required | Allowed values                |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `date`   | `string` | yes      | pattern `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |

Example call:

```json
{
  "date": "2026-10-05"
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "id": "j2026-10-05",
  "date": "2026-10-05",
  "content_markdown": "Kicked off the relaunch.",
  "sources": [
    {
      "kind": "journal",
      "id": "2026-10-05",
      "title": "Journal 2026-10-05",
      "href": "memry://journal/2026-10-05"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### vault_list_canvases

List spatial canvases with how many notes/tasks/events sit on each. Canvases live in folders, so two can share a title — each entry carries its folder and the folder-qualified path ("Work/Plan") that names it unambiguously. Never returns scene geometry.

Read tool.

Takes no arguments.

Example call:

```json
{}
```

Reply:

```json
[
  {
    "id": "<deleteCanvasId>",
    "title": "Scratch board",
    "folder": null,
    "path": "Scratch board",
    "updated_at": 1791371846105,
    "item_count": 0
  },
  {
    "id": "<canvasId>",
    "title": "Launch board",
    "folder": null,
    "path": "Launch board",
    "updated_at": 1791371846095,
    "item_count": 0
  }
]
```

#### vault_read_canvas

Read one canvas: title, the entities on it (with titles), and any text written on it. Takes the canvas id or its folder-qualified name ("Work/Plan") from vault_list_canvases; a bare title matching more than one canvas is refused with the candidates listed. Returns no scene geometry — use vault_add_canvas_item to change what is on it.

Read tool.

| Argument | Type     | Required | Allowed values |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | -------------- |
| `id`     | `string` | yes      | min length `1` |

Example call:

```json
{
  "id": "<canvasId>"
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "id": "<canvasId>",
  "title": "Launch board",
  "created_at": 1791371846095,
  "updated_at": 1791371846095,
  "items": [],
  "texts": [],
  "element_count": 0,
  "texts_truncated": false
}
```

#### vault_read_canvas_elements

Read the SHAPES on a canvas: every element with its id, type, position, size, text, colors, arrow bindings and frame. This is the read to use before drawing — an element id from here is what vault_draw_on_canvas binds an arrow to and what vault_edit_canvas_elements changes. Cards carry entity_type/entity_id. Takes the canvas id or its folder-qualified name ("Work/Plan") from vault_list_canvases; a bare title matching more than one canvas is refused with the candidates listed. Use vault_read_canvas instead when you only need to know WHICH notes/tasks/events are on it.

Read tool.

| Argument | Type     | Required | Allowed values |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | -------------- |
| `id`     | `string` | yes      | min length `1` |

Example call:

```json
{
  "id": "<canvasId>"
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "canvas_id": "<canvasId>",
  "elements": [],
  "element_count": 0,
  "truncated": false
}
```

#### vault_desktop_read

Run an allowlisted read-only desktop API operation through the memrynote window. A note in the reply that is a filed pdf/image/audio/video file comes back as its metadata with contentOmitted: true and contentAccess naming how to read it. A reply whose JSON is over 100 KB in UTF-8 bytes comes back as { truncated, totalBytes, message, partial }. `args` are the positional arguments; vault_desktop_describe returns each operation's argument schema, and a call that does not match it is refused with the field, the expected type and the allowed values. Calendar examples: calendar.listEvents with args [{}], calendar.getRange with args [{"startAt":"2026-05-14T00:00:00.000Z","endAt":"2026-06-15T00:00:00.000Z"}].

#### vault_desktop_describe

With operation, returns a summary of what it does, its tool, whether it needs approval, its parameters in call order and args_schema: the JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of the args array, with every type, required key, allowed value and default. ### Write tools

#### vault_create_note

Create a new note. Checkbox lines you add are stored as plain checkboxes, marked {check}, unless the owner turned on task conversion for agents; then they become tasks and the reply lists them in created_tasks. Create tasks with vault_create_task. Requires user approval.

Write tool; needs approval.

| Argument           | Type       | Required | Allowed values |
| ------------------ | ---------- | -------- | -------------- |
| `title`            | `string`   | yes      | min length `1` |
| `content_markdown` | `string`   | yes      |                |
| `folder_path`      | `string`   | no       |                |
| `tags`             | `string[]` | no       |                |

Example call:

```json
{
  "title": "Release notes draft",
  "content_markdown": "# Release notes\n\n- New onboarding\n",
  "folder_path": "Projects",
  "tags": ["website"]
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "id": "efoqaligj1ut",
  "title": "Release notes draft",
  "folder_path": "Projects",
  "tags": ["website"],
  "properties": {},
  "body_bytes": 34,
  "body_sha256": "54c77e654f16fdeb7d264c2ee27825368140cb51fdd6f4a2badbcdf3e4e61e8c",
  "href": "memry://note/efoqaligj1ut",
  "source_ref": {
    "kind": "note",
    "id": "efoqaligj1ut",
    "title": "Release notes draft",
    "href": "memry://note/efoqaligj1ut"
  },
  "sources": [
    {
      "kind": "note",
      "id": "efoqaligj1ut",
      "title": "Release notes draft",
      "href": "memry://note/efoqaligj1ut"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### vault_create_task

Create a new task. Without project_id it goes to the Inbox project. status_id takes an id from vault_list_statuses. due_date and due are aliases (due_date wins), as are description and notes. source_note_id links the task back to the note it came from. Requires user approval.

Write tool; needs approval.

| Argument          | Type                            | Required | Allowed values                                  |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `title`           | `string`                        | yes      | min length `1`; max length `500`                |
| `status_id`       | `string \| null`                | no       |                                                 |
| `project_id`      | `string \| null`                | no       |                                                 |
| `parent_id`       | `string \| null`                | no       |                                                 |
| `due`             | `string \| null`                | no       |                                                 |
| `due_date`        | `string \| null`                | no       |                                                 |
| `due_time`        | `string \| null`                | no       |                                                 |
| `start_date`      | `string \| null`                | no       |                                                 |
| `priority`        | `integer`                       | no       | min `0`; max `4`                                |
| `notes`           | `string \| null`                | no       |                                                 |
| `description`     | `string \| null`                | no       |                                                 |
| `is_repeating`    | `boolean`                       | no       |                                                 |
| `repeat_config`   | `Record<string, any> \| null`   | no       |                                                 |
| `repeat_from`     | `"due" \| "completion" \| null` | no       | `"due"`, `"completion"`                         |
| `tags`            | `string[]`                      | no       | max items `20`                                  |
| `linked_note_ids` | `string[]`                      | no       |                                                 |
| `source_note_id`  | `string \| null`                | no       |                                                 |
| `position`        | `integer`                       | no       | min `-9007199254740991`; max `9007199254740991` |

Example call:

```json
{
  "title": "Book the launch venue",
  "project_id": "<projectId>",
  "due_date": "2026-10-20",
  "priority": 2,
  "tags": ["launch"]
}
```

#### vault_create_status

#### vault_create_journal_entry

Create or return existing journal entry for date. Checkbox lines you add are stored as plain checkboxes, marked {check}, unless the owner turned on task conversion for agents; then they become tasks and the reply lists them in created_tasks. Create tasks with vault_create_task. Requires user approval.

Write tool; needs approval.

| Argument           | Type     | Required | Allowed values                |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `date`             | `string` | yes      | pattern `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |
| `content_markdown` | `string` | yes      |                               |

Example call:

```json
{
  "date": "2026-10-07",
  "content_markdown": "Shipped the pricing page.\n"
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "id": "j2026-10-07",
  "date": "2026-10-07",
  "tags": [],
  "properties": {},
  "body_bytes": 26,
  "body_sha256": "541df3fe694ff9c46b58b5fc0c8e175f209fd719edda1d715fae73649811578b",
  "created": true,
  "sources": [
    {
      "kind": "journal",
      "id": "2026-10-07",
      "title": "2026-10-07",
      "href": "memry://journal/2026-10-07"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### vault_update_note

Update note body. Checkbox lines you add are stored as plain checkboxes, marked {check}, unless the owner turned on task conversion for agents; then they become tasks and the reply lists them in created_tasks. Create tasks with vault_create_task. Replies with the note as stored: title, folder_path, tags, properties, body_bytes and body_sha256 (UTF-8 body as the file stores it, which ends with a newline), plus tags_added and tags_removed when inline #tags in the body changed the tag set. Requires user approval with diff preview.

#### vault_add_html_artifact

Append a self-contained HTML artifact (diagram, chart, interactive explanation) to an existing markdown note identified by `id` (the note id, not an artifact name). It is saved as a note attachment and rendered inline in a sandboxed iframe. Write one complete HTML document with inline CSS/JS. It cannot read the vault, the note, or sibling files; external scripts/styles/fonts load only over https (e.g. a CDN). Do not use alert/confirm/prompt. Keep it compact and readable in light and dark themes. Requires user approval.

Write tool; needs approval.

| Argument | Type     | Required | Allowed values                      | Notes                                                                                                                            |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | ----------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | `string` | yes      | min length `1`                      | ID of the existing note to append the artifact to, exactly as returned by a vault read/search tool. Not a name for the artifact. |
| `title`  | `string` | yes      | min length `1`; max length `120`    | Artifact title, used as the file name.                                                                                           |
| `html`   | `string` | yes      | min length `1`; max length `524288` |                                                                                                                                  |

Example call:

```json
{
  "id": "<noteId>",
  "title": "Launch timeline",
  "html": "<h1>Launch timeline</h1><ol><li>Copy freeze</li><li>QA</li><li>Go live</li></ol>"
}
```

#### vault_draw_on_canvas

Draw on a canvas: rectangles, ellipses, diamonds, text, arrows, lines, freedraw, frames, images and embeds. Element fields are Excalidraw's own skeleton fields in camelCase (strokeColor, backgroundColor, fillStyle, strokeWidth, strokeStyle, roughness, opacity, roundness, fontSize, points, ...), so a shape is e.g. {"type":"rectangle","x":0,"y":0,"width":240,"height":120,"backgroundColor":"#ffec99","label":{"text":"Chapter 1"}}. Give an element a "ref" to point arrows at it or put it in a frame within the same call; bind to something already on the canvas with {"elementId":"..."} from vault_read_canvas_elements. An arrow with start and end is a REAL binding — it follows the shapes when the user drags them: {"type":"arrow","start":{"ref":"a"},"end":{"elementId":"..."},"endArrowhead":"arrow","label":{"text":"leads to"}}. Coordinates are scene coordinates; x/y default to 0, so read the canvas first and place relative to what is there. To put a note/task/event on the canvas use vault_add_canvas_item — this tool cannot mint entity cards. Images need a fileId already attached to the canvas. Takes the canvas id or its folder-qualified name ("Work/Plan") from vault_list_canvases; a bare title matching more than one canvas is refused with the candidates listed. Requires user approval.

Write tool; needs approval.

| Argument                         | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Required | Allowed values                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `canvas_id`                      | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | yes      | min length `1`                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `elements`                       | `object[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                 | yes      | min items `1`; max items `300`                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `elements[].ref`                 | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | no       | min length `1`; max length `64`                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `elements[].type`                | `"rectangle" \| "ellipse" \| "diamond" \| "text" \| "arrow" \| "line" \| "freedraw" \| "frame" \| "image" \| "embeddable"`                                                                                 | yes      | `"rectangle"`, `"ellipse"`, `"diamond"`, `"text"`, `"arrow"`, `"line"`, `"freedraw"`, `"frame"`, `"image"`, `"embeddable"`                                                                                 |
| `elements[].x`                   | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `elements[].y`                   | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `elements[].width`               | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | no       | min `0`; max `100000`                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `elements[].height`              | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | no       | min `0`; max `100000`                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `elements[].strokeColor`         | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | no       | pattern `^(#[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\|#[0-9a-fA-F]{8}\|transparent)$`                                                                                                                               |
| `elements[].backgroundColor`     | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | no       | pattern `^(#[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\|#[0-9a-fA-F]{8}\|transparent)$`                                                                                                                               |
| `elements[].fillStyle`           | `"hachure" \| "cross-hatch" \| "solid" \| "zigzag"`                                                                                                                                                        | no       | `"hachure"`, `"cross-hatch"`, `"solid"`, `"zigzag"`                                                                                                                                                        |
| `elements[].strokeWidth`         | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | no       | max `20`; greater than `0`                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `elements[].strokeStyle`         | `"solid" \| "dashed" \| "dotted"`                                                                                                                                                                          | no       | `"solid"`, `"dashed"`, `"dotted"`                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `elements[].roughness`           | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | no       | min `0`; max `2`                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `elements[].opacity`             | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                   | no       | min `0`; max `100`                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `elements[].roundness`           | `"sharp" \| "round"`                                                                                                                                                                                       | no       | `"sharp"`, `"round"`                                                                                                                                                                                       |

#### vault_edit_canvas_elements

Move, restyle, retext or delete elements already on a canvas, by element id from vault_read_canvas_elements. Absent fields are left alone; {"delete":true} removes the element and clears any arrow bound to it. Works on entity cards too (move and restyle them), except their text, which lives in the note. Takes the canvas id or its folder-qualified name ("Work/Plan") from vault_list_canvases; a bare title matching more than one canvas is refused with the candidates listed. Requires user approval.

Write tool; needs approval.

#### vault_desktop_write

Run an allowlisted desktop CRUD mutation. `args` are the positional arguments of the operation; a call with more arguments than the operation takes is refused, so put options inside its input object. A write whose reply carries no record gets a `stored` field read back after the write. properties.set(entityId, properties) replaces the entity's whole property record: a property left out is deleted, except the legacy id, title, created and modified keys, which are kept unless the call names them (null deletes one). The reply lists the stored `properties` and the names it `removed`. Requires user approval. Replies follow the vault_desktop_read rules for filed files and replies over 100 KB. vault_desktop_describe returns each operation's argument schema; a call that does not match it is refused before approval.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

Example call:

```json
{
  "operation": "notes.ensurePropertyDefinition",
  "args": ["priority", "select"]
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "stored": {
    "name": "priority",
    "type": "select",
    "options": "[]",
    "defaultValue": null,
    "color": null,
    "createdAt": "2026-10-07T11:17:31.327Z",
    "clock": null,
    "syncedAt": null
  }
}
```

## Desktop API operations

`vault_desktop_read` runs a read operation and `vault_desktop_write` a write
operation, as `{ "operation": "notes.list", "args": [ ... ] }`. `args` holds the
operation's arguments in call order; an optional argument at the end can be left out. Each
operation below names its tool and its call shape, where `?` marks an optional argument,
then lists the arguments by name. A name like `input.title` is the key `title`
inside the argument `input`. `vault_desktop_describe` returns the same for one
operation at run time.

### Notes

#### notes.get

Read a note by id: its markdown content, frontmatter, tags and metadata.

`notes.get(id)` through `vault_desktop_read`.

| Argument | Type     | Required | Allowed values |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | -------------- |
| `id`     | `string` | yes      |                |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_read",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "notes.get",
    "args": ["<noteId>"]
  }
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "id": "<noteId>",
  "path": "Projects/Website relaunch plan.md",
  "title": "Website relaunch plan",
  "content": "# Website relaunch plan\n\nSecond draft.\n\n## Goals\n\n- Faster pages\n- Clearer pricing\n\nSee [[Launch checklist]].\n",
  "frontmatter": {
    "tags": ["website", "planning"],
    "stage": "idea",
    "project": ["Website relaunch"]
  },
  "created": "2026-10-07T11:17:24.017Z",
  "modified": "2026-10-07T11:17:25.736Z",
  "tags": ["website", "planning"],
  "aliases": [],
  "wordCount": 17,
  "properties": {
    "stage": "idea",
    "project": ["Website relaunch"]
  },
  "emoji": null
}
```

#### notes.list

List notes, filtered by folder or tags, sorted and paged.

`notes.list(options?)` through `vault_desktop_read`.

| Argument                  | Type                                               | Required | Allowed values                                                           |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `options`                 | `object \| null`                                   | no       |                                                                          |
| `options.folder`          | `string`                                           | no       |                                                                          |
| `options.tags`            | `string[]`                                         | no       |                                                                          |
| `options.sortBy`          | `"modified" \| "created" \| "title" \| "position"` | no       | `"modified"`, `"created"`, `"title"`, `"position"`; default `"modified"` |
| `options.sortOrder`       | `"asc" \| "desc"`                                  | no       | `"asc"`, `"desc"`; default `"desc"`                                      |
| `options.limit`           | `integer`                                          | no       | min `1`; max `10000`; default `100`                                      |
| `options.offset`          | `integer`                                          | no       | min `0`; max `9007199254740991`; default `0`                             |
| `options.fields`          | `"full" \| "tree"`                                 | no       | `"full"`, `"tree"`                                                       |
| `options.includeJournals` | `boolean`                                          | no       |                                                                          |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_read",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "notes.list",
    "args": [
      {
        "folder": "Projects",
        "sortBy": "title",
        "limit": 3
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Reply:


#### tasks.list

List tasks, filtered by project, status, due date or completion, sorted and paged.

`tasks.list(options?)` through `vault_desktop_read`.

| Argument                   | Type                                                               | Required | Allowed values                                                                           |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                  | `object \| null`                                                   | no       |                                                                                          |
| `options.projectId`        | `string`                                                           | no       |                                                                                          |
| `options.statusId`         | `string \| null`                                                   | no       |                                                                                          |
| `options.parentId`         | `string \| null`                                                   | no       |                                                                                          |
| `options.includeCompleted` | `boolean`                                                          | no       | default `false`                                                                          |
| `options.includeArchived`  | `boolean`                                                          | no       | default `false`                                                                          |
| `options.dueBefore`        | `string`                                                           | no       |                                                                                          |
| `options.dueAfter`         | `string`                                                           | no       |                                                                                          |
| `options.tags`             | `string[]`                                                         | no       |                                                                                          |
| `options.search`           | `string`                                                           | no       |                                                                                          |
| `options.sortBy`           | `"position" \| "dueDate" \| "priority" \| "created" \| "modified"` | no       | `"position"`, `"dueDate"`, `"priority"`, `"created"`, `"modified"`; default `"position"` |
| `options.sortOrder`        | `"asc" \| "desc"`                                                  | no       | `"asc"`, `"desc"`; default `"asc"`                                                       |
| `options.limit`            | `integer`                                                          | no       | min `1`; max `1000`; default `100`                                                       |
| `options.offset`           | `integer`                                                          | no       | min `0`; max `9007199254740991`; default `0`                                             |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_read",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "tasks.list",
    "args": [
      {
        "projectId": "<projectId>",
        "sortBy": "priority",
        "limit": 3

}
```

#### inbox.list

List inbox items, filtered by type and paged.

`inbox.list(options?)` through `vault_desktop_read`.

| Argument                 | Type                                                                                  | Required | Allowed values                                                                        |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                | `object \| null`                                                                      | no       |                                                                                       |
| `options.type`           | `"link" \| "note" \| "image" \| "voice" \| "clip" \| "pdf" \| "social" \| "reminder"` | no       | `"link"`, `"note"`, `"image"`, `"voice"`, `"clip"`, `"pdf"`, `"social"`, `"reminder"` |
| `options.includeSnoozed` | `boolean`                                                                             | no       | default `false`                                                                       |
| `options.sortBy`         | `"created" \| "modified" \| "title"`                                                  | no       | `"created"`, `"modified"`, `"title"`; default `"created"`                             |
| `options.sortOrder`      | `"asc" \| "desc"`                                                                     | no       | `"asc"`, `"desc"`; default `"desc"`                                                   |
| `options.limit`          | `integer`                                                                             | no       | min `1`; max `200`; default `50`                                                      |
| `options.offset`         | `integer`                                                                             | no       | min `0`; max `9007199254740991`; default `0`                                          |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_read",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "inbox.list",
    "args": [
      {
        "type": "note",
        "limit": 3
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

```json
{

}

}
```

#### reminders.list

List reminders, filtered by target or status.

`reminders.list(options?)` through `vault_desktop_read`.

| Argument             | Type                                                                                                               | Required | Allowed values                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`            | `object \| null`                                                                                                   | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `options.targetType` | `"note" \| "journal" \| "highlight" \| "task" \| "note_date"`                                                      | no       | `"note"`, `"journal"`, `"highlight"`, `"task"`, `"note_date"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `options.targetId`   | `string`                                                                                                           | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `options.status`     | `"pending" \| "triggered" \| "dismissed" \| "snoozed" \| ("pending" \| "triggered" \| "dismissed" \| "snoozed")[]` | no       | `"pending"`, `"triggered"`, `"dismissed"`, `"snoozed"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `options.fromDate`   | `string`                                                                                                           | no       | format `date-time`; pattern `^(?:(?:\d\d[2468][048]\|\d\d[13579][26]\|\d\d0[48]\|[02468][048]00\|[13579][26]00)-02-29\|\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]\|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|3[01])\|(?:0[469]\|11)-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|30)\|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]\|1\d\|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\d\|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d(?::[0-5]\d(?:\.\d+)?)?(?:Z))$` |
| `options.toDate`     | `string`                                                                                                           | no       | format `date-time`; pattern `^(?:(?:\d\d[2468][048]\|\d\d[13579][26]\|\d\d0[48]\|[02468][048]00\|[13579][26]00)-02-29\|\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]\|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|3[01])\|(?:0[469]\|11)-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|30)\|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]\|1\d\|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\d\|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d(?::[0-5]\d(?:\.\d+)?)?(?:Z))$` |
| `options.limit`      | `integer`                                                                                                          | no       | min `1`; max `200`; default `50`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `options.offset`     | `integer`                                                                                                          | no       | min `0`; max `9007199254740991`; default `0`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_read",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "reminders.list",
    "args": [
      {
        "targetType": "note",
        "status": "pending",
        "limit": 3
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

```json
{
```
```json
  "name": "vault_desktop_read",
```

```json
    "operation": "settings.get",
```

```json
"on"
```

### Search

#### search.query

Full-text search across notes, tasks, journal entries and inbox items.

`search.query(params)` through `vault_desktop_read`.

| Argument                | Type                                                       | Required | Allowed values                   |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------- |
| `params`                | `object`                                                   | yes      |                                  |
| `params.text`           | `string`                                                   | yes      | max length `500`                 |
| `params.types`          | `("note" \| "journal" \| "task" \| "inbox")[]`             | no       | default `[]`                     |
| `params.tags`           | `string[]`                                                 | no       | default `[]`                     |
| `params.dateRange`      | `object \| null`                                           | no       | default `null`                   |
| `params.dateRange.from` | `string`                                                   | yes      |                                  |
| `params.dateRange.to`   | `string`                                                   | yes      |                                  |
| `params.projectId`      | `string \| null`                                           | no       | default `null`                   |
| `params.folderPath`     | `string \| null`                                           | no       | default `null`                   |
| `params.limit`          | `number`                                                   | no       | min `1`; max `100`; default `10` |
| `params.offset`         | `number`                                                   | no       | min `0`; default `0`             |
| `params.noteFileTypes`  | `("markdown" \| "pdf" \| "image" \| "audio" \| "video")[]` | no       | min items `1`                    |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_read",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "search.query",
    "args": [
      {
        "text": "relaunch",
        "types": ["note", "task"],
        "limit": 3
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "groups": [
    {
      "type": "note",
      "results": [
        {
          "id": "<noteId>",
          "type": "note",
          "title": "Website relaunch plan",
          "snippet": "# Website <mark>relaunch</mark> plan\n\nSecond draft.\n\n## Goals\n\n- Faster pages\n- Clearer pricing\n\nSee [[Launch checklist]].\n",
          "score": 2.197131341983295,
          "normalizedScore": 1,
          "matchType": "exact",
          "modifiedAt": "2026-10-07T11:17:25.736Z",
          "metadata": {
            "type": "note",
            "path": "Projects/Website relaunch plan.md",
            "tags": [],
            "emoji": null,
            "fileType": "markdown",
            "wordCount": 17,
            "createdAt": "2026-10-07T11:17:24.017Z"
          }
        }
      ],
      "totalInGroup": 1
    }
  ],
  "totalCount": 1,
  "queryTimeMs": 1
}
```

#### search.quick

The fast search behind the command palette: a few hits per type.

`search.quick(text, noteFileTypes?)` through `vault_desktop_read`.

| Argument        | Type                                                       | Required | Allowed values |

| `text`          | `string`                                                   | yes      |                |
| `noteFileTypes` | `("markdown" \| "pdf" \| "image" \| "audio" \| "video")[]` | no       | min items `1`  |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_read",

}
```

### Notes

#### notes.create

Create a note from markdown, in a folder, with tags and properties.

`notes.create(input)` through `vault_desktop_write`; needs approval.

| Argument           | Type                  | Required | Allowed values                   |
| ------------------ | --------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------- |
| `input`            | `object`              | yes      |                                  |
| `input.title`      | `string`              | yes      | min length `1`; max length `200` |
| `input.content`    | `string`              | no       | default `""`                     |
| `input.folder`     | `string`              | no       |                                  |
| `input.tags`       | `string[]`            | no       | max items `50`                   |
| `input.template`   | `string`              | no       |                                  |
| `input.properties` | `Record<string, any>` | no       |                                  |
| `input.emoji`      | `string \| null`      | no       |                                  |

Example call:

```json
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",

    "operation": "notes.create",

        "title": "Press kit",

        "folder": "Projects",
        "tags": ["website"]

}
```

#### notes.uploadAttachment

Attach a file to a note. JSON cannot carry the file, so this fails for agents.

`notes.uploadAttachment(noteId, file)` through `vault_desktop_write`; needs approval.

| Argument           | Type     | Required | Allowed values | Notes                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `noteId`           | `string` | yes      |                |                                                                                                                            |
| `file`             | `object` | yes      |                | A File-like object whose arrayBuffer() returns the bytes. JSON cannot carry one, so an agent call to this operation fails. |
| `file.name`        | `string` | yes      |                |                                                                                                                            |
| `file.arrayBuffer` | `any`    | yes      |                |                                                                                                                            |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "notes.uploadAttachment",
    "args": [
      "<noteId>",
      {
        "name": "photo.png",
        "arrayBuffer": null
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Reply (an error):

```json
{
  "code": "INTERNAL",
  "message": "file.arrayBuffer is not a function",
  "details": {
    "operation": "notes.uploadAttachment",
    "code": "DESKTOP_API_ERROR"
  }
}
```

### Tasks and projects

#### tasks.create

Create a task in a project.

`tasks.create(input)` through `vault_desktop_write`; needs approval.

| Argument                               | Type                                           | Required | Allowed values                                  |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `input`                                | `object`                                       | yes      |                                                 |
| `input.projectId`                      | `string`                                       | yes      |                                                 |
| `input.title`                          | `string`                                       | yes      | min length `1`; max length `500`                |
| `input.description`                    | `string \| null`                               | no       |                                                 |
| `input.priority`                       | `integer`                                      | no       | min `0`; max `4`; default `0`                   |
| `input.statusId`                       | `string \| null`                               | no       |                                                 |
| `input.parentId`                       | `string \| null`                               | no       |                                                 |
| `input.dueDate`                        | `string \| null`                               | no       |                                                 |
| `input.dueTime`                        | `string \| null`                               | no       |                                                 |
| `input.startDate`                      | `string \| null`                               | no       |                                                 |
| `input.isRepeating`                    | `boolean`                                      | no       | default `false`                                 |
| `input.repeatConfig`                   | `object \| null`                               | no       |                                                 |
| `input.repeatConfig.frequency`         | `"daily" \| "weekly" \| "monthly" \| "yearly"` | yes      | `"daily"`, `"weekly"`, `"monthly"`, `"yearly"`  |
| `input.repeatConfig.interval`          | `integer`                                      | no       | min `1`; max `9007199254740991`; default `1`    |
| `input.repeatConfig.daysOfWeek`        | `integer[]`                                    | no       |                                                 |
| `input.repeatConfig.monthlyType`       | `"dayOfMonth" \| "weekPattern"`                | no       | `"dayOfMonth"`, `"weekPattern"`                 |
| `input.repeatConfig.dayOfMonth`        | `integer`                                      | no       | min `1`; max `31`                               |
| `input.repeatConfig.weekOfMonth`       | `integer`                                      | no       | min `1`; max `5`                                |
| `input.repeatConfig.dayOfWeekForMonth` | `integer`                                      | no       | min `0`; max `6`                                |
| `input.repeatConfig.endType`           | `"never" \| "date" \| "count"`                 | yes      | `"never"`, `"date"`, `"count"`                  |
| `input.repeatConfig.endDate`           | `string \| null`                               | no       |                                                 |
| `input.repeatConfig.endCount`          | `integer`                                      | no       | min `1`; max `9007199254740991`                 |
| `input.repeatConfig.completedCount`    | `integer`                                      | no       | min `0`; max `9007199254740991`; default `0`    |
| `input.repeatConfig.createdAt`         | `string`                                       | yes      |                                                 |
| `input.repeatFrom`                     | `"due" \| "completion" \| null`                | no       | `"due"`, `"completion"`                         |
| `input.tags`                           | `string[]`                                     | no       | max items `20`                                  |
| `input.linkedNoteIds`                  | `string[]`                                     | no       |                                                 |
| `input.linkedCanvasIds`                | `string[]`                                     | no       |                                                 |
| `input.sourceNoteId`                   | `string \| null`                               | no       |                                                 |
| `input.position`                       | `integer`                                      | no       | min `-9007199254740991`; max `9007199254740991` |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "tasks.create",
    "args": [
      {
        "projectId": "<projectId>",
        "title": "Order the launch cake",
        "priority": 1,
        "dueDate": "2026-10-21"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

| `input.repeatConfig.completedCount`    | `integer`                                      | no       | min `0`; max `9007199254740991`; default `0`   |

| `input.repeatFrom`                     | `"due" \| "completion" \| null`                | no       | `"due"`, `"completion"`                        |
| `input.tags`                           | `string[]`                                     | no       | max items `20`                                 |
| `input.linkedNoteIds`                  | `string[]`                                     | no       |                                                |
| `input.linkedCanvasIds`                | `string[]`                                     | no       |                                                |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",

    "args": [

    ]

}
```

| `input.statuses[].id`    | `string`                            | no       |                                                  |
| `input.statuses[].name`  | `string`                            | yes      | min length `1`; max length `50`                  |
| `input.statuses[].color` | `string`                            | no       | pattern `^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$`; default `"#6b7280"` |
| `input.statuses[].type`  | `"todo" \| "in_progress" \| "done"` | yes      | `"todo"`, `"in_progress"`, `"done"`              |
| `input.statuses[].order` | `integer`                           | yes      | min `0`; max `9007199254740991`                  |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "tasks.updateProject",
    "args": [
      {
        "id": "<project3Id>",
        "name": "Website relaunch v2"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

#### inbox.captureText

Capture a text note into the inbox.

`inbox.captureText(input)` through `vault_desktop_write`; needs approval.

| Argument        | Type                                                                        | Required | Allowed values                                                              |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `input`         | `object`                                                                    | yes      |                                                                             |
| `input.content` | `string`                                                                    | yes      | min length `1`; max length `50000`                                          |
| `input.title`   | `string`                                                                    | no       | min length `1`; max length `200`                                            |
| `input.tags`    | `string[]`                                                                  | no       | max items `20`                                                              |
| `input.force`   | `boolean`                                                                   | no       |                                                                             |
| `input.source`  | `"quick-capture" \| "inline" \| "browser-extension" \| "api" \| "reminder"` | no       | `"quick-capture"`, `"inline"`, `"browser-extension"`, `"api"`, `"reminder"` |

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",

    "operation": "inbox.captureText",
    "args": [
      {
        "content": "Ask Sam for the hero photo",
        "title": "Hero photo",
        "tags": ["website"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

#### inbox.bulkFile

File several inbox items into one place.

`inbox.bulkFile(input)` through `vault_desktop_write`; needs approval.

| Argument                   | Type                               | Required | Allowed values                     |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `input`                    | `object`                           | yes      |                                    |
| `input.itemIds`            | `string[]`                         | yes      | min items `1`; max items `100`     |
| `input.destination`        | `object`                           | yes      |                                    |
| `input.destination.type`   | `"folder" \| "note" \| "new-note"` | yes      | `"folder"`, `"note"`, `"new-note"` |
| `input.destination.path`   | `string`                           | no       |                                    |
| `input.destination.noteId` | `string`                           | no       |                                    |
| `input.tags`               | `string[]`                         | no       | max items `20`                     |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "inbox.bulkFile",
    "args": [
      {
        "itemIds": ["<inbox12Id>"],
        "destination": {
          "type": "folder",
          "path": "Projects"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "processedCount": 1,
  "errors": []
}
```

### Saved filters

#### savedFilters.create

Save a task filter.

`savedFilters.create(input)` through `vault_desktop_write`; needs approval.

| Argument                           | Type                                                                                                                                                                                  | Required | Allowed values                                                                                                      |

| `input`                            | `object`                                                                                                                                                                              | yes      |                                                                                                                     |

| `input.config.filters.priorities`  | `("urgent" \| "high" \| "medium" \| "low" \| "none")[]`                                                                                                                               | no       | default `[]`                                                                                                        |
| `input.config.filters.tags`        | `string[]`                                                                                                                                                                            | no       | default `[]`                                                                                                        |
| `input.config.filters.dueDate`     | `{ type: "any" \| "none" \| "overdue" \| "today" \| "tomorrow" \| "this-week" \| "next-week" \| "this-month" \| "custom", customStart?: string \| null, customEnd?: string \| null }` | no       | default `{"type":"any","customStart":null,"customEnd":null}`                                                        |
| `input.config.filters.statusIds`   | `string[]`                                                                                                                                                                            | no       | default `[]`                                                                                                        |
| `input.config.filters.completion`  | `"active" \| "completed" \| "all" \| "archived"`                                                                                                                                      | no       | `"active"`, `"completed"`, `"all"`, `"archived"`; default `"active"`                                                |
| `input.config.filters.repeatType`  | `"all" \| "repeating" \| "one-time"`                                                                                                                                                  | no       | `"all"`, `"repeating"`, `"one-time"`; default `"all"`                                                               |
| `input.config.filters.hasTime`     | `"all" \| "with-time" \| "without-time"`                                                                                                                                              | no       | `"all"`, `"with-time"`, `"without-time"`; default `"all"`                                                           |
| `input.config.filters.folderPaths` | `string[]`                                                                                                                                                                            | no       |                                                                                                                     |
| `input.config.filters.noteIds`     | `string[]`                                                                                                                                                                            | no       |                                                                                                                     |
| `input.config.sort`                | `object`                                                                                                                                                                              | no       |                                                                                                                     |
| `input.config.sort.field`          | `"dueDate" \| "priority" \| "status" \| "createdAt" \| "title" \| "project" \| "completedAt" \| "folder" \| "note"`                                                                   | yes      | `"dueDate"`, `"priority"`, `"status"`, `"createdAt"`, `"title"`, `"project"`, `"completedAt"`, `"folder"`, `"note"` |
| `input.config.sort.direction`      | `"asc" \| "desc"`                                                                                                                                                                     | yes      | `"asc"`, `"desc"`                                                                                                   |
| `input.config.starred`             | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                                             | no       |                                                                                                                     |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "savedFilters.create",
    "args": [
      {
        "name": "Urgent website tasks",
        "config": {
          "filters": {

          }

}
```

```json
        },
        "statusIds": [],
        "completion": "active",
        "repeatType": "all",
        "hasTime": "all"
      }
    },
    "position": 1,
    "createdAt": "2026-10-07T11:17:34.869Z"
  }
}
```

| `config.views[].order`                 | `object[]`                                                                                                                                                 | no       |                                                  |

| ----------- | -------- | -------- | -------------- |
| `vaultPath` | `string` | yes      |                |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "vault.switch",
    "args": ["/Users/me/Documents/Other vault"]
  }
}
```

No example reply: switching the open vault ends the agent session, so the example is not run.

```json
null
```

`vault.downloadRemote(vaultUuid, parentPath?)` through `vault_desktop_write`; needs approval.

| Argument     | Type     | Required | Allowed values |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- | -------------- |
| `vaultUuid`  | `string` | yes      | min length `1` |
| `parentPath` | `string` | no       |                |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "vault.downloadRemote",
    "args": ["3f6c2a1e-8b4d-4c1a-9e2f-5d7a8b9c0d1e", "/Users/me/Documents"]
  }
}
```

No example reply: it needs a signed-in account with a vault on the sync server, so the example is not run.

### Canvas

#### canvas.create

Create an empty canvas.

`canvas.create(input?)` through `vault_desktop_write`; needs approval.

| Argument            | Type             | Required | Allowed values |
| ------------------- | ---------------- | -------- | -------------- |
| `input`             | `object \| null` | no       |                |
| `input.title`       | `string \| null` | no       |                |
| `input.scene`       | `string`         | no       |                |
| `input.folder`      | `string \| null` | no       |                |
| `input.icon`        | `string \| null` | no       |                |
| `input.ownerNoteId` | `string \| null` | no       |                |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "canvas.create",
    "args": [
      {
        "title": "Sitemap"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "id": "pnB8GGcsxY4P6rfo8Gzkh",
  "title": "Sitemap",
  "folder": null,
  "icon": null,
  "ownerNoteId": null,
  "createdAt": 1791371857488,
  "updatedAt": 1791371857488,
  "scene": "{\"type\":\"excalidraw\",\"version\":2,\"source\":\"memry\",\"elements\":[],\"appState\":{},\"files\":{}}"
}
```

#### canvas.delete

Delete a canvas.

`canvas.delete(id)` through `vault_desktop_write`; needs approval.

| Argument | Type     | Required | Allowed values |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | -------------- |
| `id`     | `string` | yes      |                |

Example call:

```json
{
  "name": "vault_desktop_write",
  "arguments": {
    "operation": "canvas.delete",
    "args": ["<deleteCanvasId>"]
  }
}
```

Reply:

```json
{
  "success": true
}
```
